# Outcomes

The proposed engagement will advance PURE FINANCIAL ADVISORS LLC’s data maturity by delivering an automated, integrated reporting suite focused on Lead-to-AUM (L2A) and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) metrics. This initiative will provide actionable and granular insights, enabling data-driven decisions that improve marketing efficiency and pipeline performance. By equipping leadership and key business teams with enriched analytics, PURE will gain a transparent view of the client journey and realize greater returns on marketing investments.

## Expected Business Outcomes

- **Improved Pipeline Visibility:** Attain a detailed, end-to-end understanding of the conversion journey from initial lead through to assets under management, empowering teams to identify and address bottlenecks in the acquisition funnel.

- **Actionable CAC Insights:** Deliver accurate, timely, and integrated reporting on Customer Acquisition Cost, allowing for precise measurement of marketing spend effectiveness and aiding resource allocation strategies.

- **Enhanced Data-Driven Decision Making:** Enable leadership and key stakeholders to make informed, evidence-based decisions using clearly defined KPIs, ongoing data quality assessments, and robust Power BI dashboards.

- **Automated Reporting & Data Processes:** Reduce manual effort and margin for error by implementing automated ingestion, transformation, and reporting refreshes, resulting in more consistently up-to-date analytics.

- **Scalable Analytics Infrastructure:** Lay the groundwork for sustainable growth by building a reporting platform that can seamlessly integrate future data sources and scale with business needs.

- **Marketing ROI Optimization:** Support continuous improvement in marketing strategies by providing transparent, real-time insights into the return on marketing investment, increasing accountability and performance across campaigns.
